reviews.review_description: The whole image is like your lying on the floor and the controls are pointing somewhere completely else. Extremely buggy software. Refund please.

developer_response.body:
Hi

We regret to know you faced this issue. There is a calibration option in settings in the game. Please go to settings from main menu and calibrate. This will resolve your issue. If it still persist, feel free to contact oue support and we will assist you on the bug.

Thank you

Team UCR

reviews.review_description: Ultimate Car Racing VR delivers high-speed, immersive cockpit racing with impressive physics and crisp visuals. At just $7.99, its offline single-player modes offer an absolute steal for thrill-seeking drivers on Meta Quest.
The controls are incredibly easy to learn. It focuses entirely on pure, arcade-style fun. You get tons of content to unlock. Racing inside the cockpit feels absolutely amazing!
